summary: Connect a nonnegative profile, its sweep and volume slices.
objective: Revolve a nonnegative curve around the x axis and show how disk slices estimate its volume.
example_prompts: Revolve a nonnegative curve around the x axis and show how disk slices estimate its volume.

entities.name: Profile
entities.guidance: Keep the generating curve and filled source region visible in a fixed plane with axis units.

entities.name: Sweep shell
entities.guidance: Derive rings from radius f(x), retain seam continuity and cap endpoints; show surface versus filled volume distinctly.

entities.name: Disk samples
entities.guidance: Use thin translucent disks with width labels; opacity must not imply density.

state_contract.model: Continuous nonnegative f on [a,b], x-axis rotation and numerical quadrature configuration.
state_contract.authority: One canonical model owns semantic values; derive geometry and labels from it. Keep presentation transforms separate.
actions: Adjust disk count and compare volume estimate.

invariants: At full revolution the shell agrees with the sampled profile.
Display cubic units; separate quadrature error from mesh resolution.
motion_guidance: Sweep angle is presentation progress, not physical rotation dynamics.
Show disk estimates at rest to avoid conflating a transient partial sweep with full volume.
known_limits: Functions crossing the axis or cavities need a separate region/washer contract.
Numerical integration implementation and convergence remain untested.
Authored guidance; no scene runtime or visual verification has run for this recipe.

claims.statement: For continuous nonnegative f, revolving the region under f on [a,b] around the x axis gives volume integral_a^b pi*f(x)^2 dx.
claims.scope: Disk method for the bounded region specified.
